ablegen.hinweis: The Workbench is for setting things up – you file documents in the library.
nummernkreise.diesen-nummernkreis-gibt-e: This number sequence doesn’t exist (any more).
nummernkreise.gespeichert-das-muster-gil: Saved. The pattern applies to new numbers.
nummernkreise.im-standardwert-eines-text: In the default value of a text field: {code}
nummernkreise.name: Name
nummernkreise.loeschen-gesperrt: These fields still take numbers from the sequence. Remove it from their default value first.
nummernkreise.die-naechste-nummer-bekomm: The next number gets the counter {zaehler}. This is recorded in the log.
nummernkreise.zaehler-der-naechsten-numm: Counter of the next number, e.g. when switching from another program
nummernkreise.noch-in-keinem-feld: Not in any field yet. In the folder type, enter {code} as the default value of a text field.
nummernkreise.mappen-die-angelegt-wurden: Folders created before the field got a number sequence have no number. This assigns them in the order of creation; today counts as the date.
nummernkreise.kein-feld-nutzt-einen: No field uses a number sequence.
nummernkreise.alle-mappen-haben-schon: All folders already have a number.
nummernkreise.gespeichert-diese-nummern-: “{name}” saved. These numbers now count as assigned.
nummernkreise.ein-pdf-mit-aufklebern: A PDF with stickers from {code}: barcode (Code 128) and readable number. Stick it on the paper original, enter it on the document in Ablago – or scan it into the search field with a hand scanner. Print at 100 %, not “fit to page”.
nummernkreise.1-oben-links-zeilenweise: 1 = top left, row by row – for partly used sheets
nummernkreise.muster.erklaerung: {jjjj} {jj} {mm} {tt} – date of drawing; {zaehler} or {zaehler:7} with leading zeros
rundgaenge.fehler.lang: The file is too long (at most {max} characters).
rundgaenge.fehler.einer: The file must contain exactly one tour – with schluessel, titel, beschreibung and schritte.
rundgaenge.fehler.konflikt: Someone else has saved in the meantime. Nothing was overwritten – “Discard” shows the new state.
rundgaenge.fehler.pruefung: The tour still has errors – “Check” shows them with their line.
rundgaenge.fehler.gibt-es-nicht: This tour does not exist (any more).
rundgaenge.fehler.doppelt: There is already an own tour “{schluessel}”.
rundgaenge.ui.beschreibung: Short guided tours of the real interface – from Ablago, from packages and your own.
rundgaenge.ui.start.erste-anmeldung: the first time you sign in
rundgaenge.ui.ungueltig: Does not apply at the moment – “Check” shows why.
rundgaenge.ui.waehlen: Choose a tour – or create your own with “+ Tour”.
rundgaenge.ui.schalter.aus: Switched off: it is not under “Discover Ablago” for anyone, is not offered and does not start by itself.
rundgaenge.ui.datei.hinweis: One tour with schluessel, titel, beschreibung and at most 8 schritte; you write the texts directly into it. Same format as the tours of Ablago and the packages.
rundgaenge.ui.ausprobieren.titel: Starts the tour in a new window, only for you – even unsaved.
rundgaenge.ui.ziel-zeigen.titel: Opens Ablago in a new window: click a highlighted place there, and its anchor is inserted at the cursor.
rundgaenge.ui.fenster.blockiert: The new window was blocked – allow Ablago to open windows.
rundgaenge.ui.entwurf-zurueck: Your draft from trying it out is back. It is not saved yet.
rundgaenge.ui.vorlage:
schluessel: my_tour
titel: My tour
beschreibung: What this tour shows.
fuer: lesen
schritte:
  - schluessel: neu
    ziel: neu
    ort: At the top in the header
    titel: Filing something
    text: With “+ New” you file post or create a folder.
rundgaenge.hilfe.text: A click inserts the anchor at the cursor.
rundgaenge.hilfe.typ.titel: Fields and registers of a folder
rundgaenge.hilfe.typ.hinweis: Applies in a tour with “oeffne: mappe” or “oeffne: neu” of this type.
rundgaenge.hilfe.typ.tipp: With this folder type as “Only whoever may read” the tip opens the first folder of this type.
tipps.fehler.pruefung: The tip still has errors – they are shown at the fields.
tipps.fehler.gibt-es-nicht: This tip does not exist (any more).
tipps.ui.beschreibung: The tip of the day and “Discover Ablago” – from Ablago, from packages and your own.
tipps.ui.waehlen: Choose a tip – or write your own with “+ Tip”.
tipps.ui.schalter.aus: Switched off: it does not appear for anyone, not even under “Discover Ablago”.
tipps.ui.text.hinweis: At most 160 characters and two sentences. {anzahl} of 160 characters.
tipps.ui.bereich.hinweis: On “Discover Ablago” the tip is listed under this area.
tipps.ui.ziel.hinweis: Ablago opens the page and highlights the place. Fields and registers of a folder are available when a folder type is chosen below.
tipps.ui.typ: Only whoever may read this folder type
tipps.ui.vorschau.leer: The tip appears here as soon as you write a text.
tipps.ui.ausprobieren.titel: Opens the target in a new window, like “Show me” in the assistant.
tipps.ui.ausprobieren.keine-mappe: There is no folder of this type yet that you may read.
tipps.ui.anpassung: Adapted – the original is kept. An update of the package leaves the adaptation in place.
tipps.ui.original-geaendert: The original has changed since your adaptation (e.g. through an update). Your adaptation still applies.
tipps.ui.funktion: Only appears when the feature is switched on ({funktion}).
tipps.ui.ungueltig: Does not apply at the moment: {grund}
beispielablage.text: See what a filled Library looks like before you file your own documents: an invented family with contracts, invoices, insurance, deadlines and post. Everything is marked as an example and gone again in one click – your own data stays untouched.
beispielablage.anlegen.text: Ablago creates the example folders of the installed packages, including example documents. They don’t trigger automations or notifications. This needs these packages:
beispielablage.da.text_one: The Library contains {anzahl} example folder from packages.
beispielablage.da.text_other: The Library contains {anzahl} example folders from packages.
beispielablage.entfernen.rueckfrage: Unchanged example folders are removed permanently with their documents, without the bin. Changed examples and your own data stay.
beispielablage.behalten_one: {anzahl} stays because it was changed or is linked: {titel}.
beispielablage.behalten_other: {anzahl} stay because they were changed or are linked: {titel}.
beispielablage.uebersicht_one: The example Library is there: {anzahl} example folder.
beispielablage.uebersicht_other: The example Library is there: {anzahl} example folders.
beispielablage.uebersicht.text: Remove it once you have looked around – your own data stays.
